mainEntity.name: How much money do I actually need to learn AI and start an online business?

acceptedAnswer.text:
You can learn the basics without paying for every tool or program immediately. Run My AI Biz describes a free starting option and a $9-per-month paid newsletter subscription for full weekly issues; separate mastermind resources may have their own terms and should be evaluated independently.

Your total cost may also include an AI platform, email provider, website or checkout service, automation software, and domain. Costs vary by plan and usage, so compare the complete workflow rather than the headline price.

Key factors:
- Which features are included in each plan.
- Whether you need integrations or higher usage limits.
- The cost of replacing manual work.
- Whether the workflow has been tested before adding subscriptions.

Start with the least expensive setup that can test your idea. Keep a monthly tool list, cancel unused services, and estimate value using time saved, completed work, or validated customer interest.

Run My AI Biz’s educational subscription can be considered separately from any promoted third-party resource.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can begin with free educational material and a small tool setup. Run My AI Biz lists a free starting option and a $9-per-month paid newsletter for full weekly issues, while other platforms and resources may add separate costs.
